label: ASUS RS500A-E11-RS12U 1U rack server
description: 1U single-socket AMD EPYC rack server with two 1GbE ports (Intel i350-AM2) and a 1GbE management port on the ASMB10/AST2600 BMC. One OCP 3.0 socket and three PCIe 4.0 slots carry 10/25GbE adapters.
notes: Onboard: 2x 1GbE i350-AM2 (RJ45) only - there is no 10G copper on the board. OCP 3.0 socket (Gen4 x16) is the natural home for a 10/25GbE mezzanine card; 3x PCIe 4.0 slots (1x x16 FH, 1x x16 LP, 1x x8 LP). BMC management port is separate.
